annotation.title_clean: AI and Robotics in Smart City Governance: Ethical and Legal Pathways for Sustainable Urbanization
annotation.title_en: AI and Robotics in Smart City Governance: Ethical and Legal Pathways for Sustainable Urbanization
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Raghav, A.; Singh, B.; Raghav, R.; Edina, K.D.
annotation.venue: Machine Learning and Robotics in Urban Planning and Management (IGI Global Scientific Publishing)
annotation.summary_en: Book chapter on how machine learning and robotics reshape smart city governance, covering ethical, legal and policy challenges such as privacy, security, algorithmic bias, automation versus human involvement, and inequality. It offers policy recommendations for equitable, secure and sustainable smart cities. Only the abstract and catalogue metadata are available.
key_provisions_or_claims: ML and robotics increase efficiency and sustainability in smart city management.
Data privacy, security and algorithmic bias require a structured regulatory framework.
Ethical tension exists between automation and human involvement, and transparency.
Policy recommendations aim at equitable, secure, sustainable smart cities.
